Number is the damage dealt in the inner explosion sphere. Splash damage is decreased linearly if the enemy is in the outer explosion sphere.
DPS is calculated as (Damage × Ammo) ÷ (Reload Time + (Firerate × Ammo)) + Splash Damage ÷ Missile Cooldown. DPS assumes bullets only hit one enemy and does not account for rev-up time.
Total DPS is calculated as Gun DPS + Missile DPS.
Missile DPS assumes that only one enemy is hit and receives the full explosive damage.
